source.title: Congruence lattice on Bruck-Reilly extensions: Results and open problems

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL. Direct shell fetch of https://zbmath.org/1488847 failed with a DNS resolution error, and browser fetch did not yield readable full text. The official zbMATH API record for document 1488847 resolved metadata only: identifier 0957.20036, title, authors, source pages 99-111, and an editorial review. The API record exposed no full-text links, and the review text was not used for extraction.

Failure mode classified as metadata_only after bounded exact-work recovery. Attempts included exact-title PDF search, exact-title search with authors, exact-title search with source volume, ISBN/source-volume search, Crossref title lookup, OpenAlex title lookup, MaRDI publication page lookup, Polimi repository lookup, and WorldCat/book-catalog lookup. Rejected candidates because they were metadata-only, catalog/sales pages, blocked repository pages, no-file repository records, unrelated search hits, or different works. The related Crossref DOI 10.1007/s10011-000-0059-4 was rejected because its title is The Congruence Lattice of Bruck-Reilly Extensions, not the requested source.

No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML page containing the problem statements was recovered. The source adequacy gate prevents extracting open problems from zbMATH metadata, editorial review text, repository metadata, catalog pages, search snippets, or related papers.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/1488847.json and outputs/latest.json.
